summary: Worksport filed an 8-K disclosing a warrant exercise inducement offer with a holder of existing warrants. The holder agreed to exercise 3,840,421 warrants at a reduced exercise price of $0.60 per share, generating approximately $2.30 million gross proceeds, in exchange for new inducement warrants covering 4,800,526 shares (125% of exercised shares). Maxim Group acted as financial advisor. The transaction closes on August 28, 2026, with a resale registration statement due within 40 days. Watch for registration effectiveness and potential dilution from inducement warrants.
